name: 完整句的基本要素：主詞與動詞
description: 每個完整句必須恰有一組主詞與限定動詞。Structure 題最常挖空主詞或動詞，選項中混入多動詞、無動詞或重複主詞的干擾。

example.sentence: ------- of the ozone layer has become a major concern among scientists.

error_patterns: 選項造成雙動詞（兩個限定動詞無連接詞）
主詞重複（名詞 + 代名詞疊用）

name: 同位格
description: 名詞後接逗號夾住的名詞片語補充說明，片語內不可再出現限定動詞。ITP Structure 經典句型：地名/人名, ______, 主要子句。

example.sentence: Geysers have often been compared to volcanoes because both emit hot liquids from below Earth's surface.

error_patterns: 同位格片語內誤加動詞（is/was）
誤用關係代名詞開頭卻無動詞

name: 片語與子句的區辨
description: 子句有主詞+限定動詞、片語沒有。挖空處在連接詞之後須接子句、在介係詞之後須接名詞片語或動名詞。

example.sentence: Despite the heavy rain, the outdoor concert continued as scheduled.

name: 主謂一致：介係詞片語干擾
description: 主詞與動詞被介係詞片語隔開時，動詞單複數仍依真正主詞。of 片語內的名詞是最常見干擾。

example.sentence: The number of students enrolled in online courses has increased dramatically.

error_patterns: 動詞誤依鄰近名詞而非主詞變化
a number of（複數）與 the number of（單數）混淆

name: 主謂一致：不定代名詞與 each/every
description: each、every、everyone、either、neither 等作主詞視為單數。neither...nor 連接時動詞依最近的主詞。

example.sentence: Each of the proposals submitted to the committee was reviewed carefully.

name: 主謂一致：集合名詞與學科名詞
description: physics、economics 等 -s 結尾學科名詞為單數；the police、people 為複數；集合名詞（family、committee）美式通常視為單數。

example.sentence: Economics is often described as the study of scarcity and choice.

error_patterns: -s 結尾學科名詞誤用複數動詞

name: 時態一致與時間標記
description: 句中時間副詞（in 1900、since、by the time、so far）決定時態。歷史事實用過去簡單式、since + 完成式、by + 過去時間點用過去完成式。

example.sentence: By the time the firefighters arrived, the building had already burned to the ground.

error_patterns: 過去時間標記配現在式
since/for 配簡單式而非完成式
過去完成式與過去簡單式順序顛倒

name: 時間/條件副詞子句用現在式代未來
description: when、before、after、as soon as、if 引導的副詞子句中，即使指未來也用現在式，主要子句才用未來式。

example.sentence: As soon as the results are announced, the university will notify all applicants.

error_patterns: 時間副詞子句誤用 will

name: 語態：V-ed 與 V-ing 的選擇
description: 主詞是動作承受者用被動（be + V-ed），是執行者用主動。Written Expression 高頻考點：conducting/conducted、interesting/interested 這類分詞混淆。

example.sentence: The experiment was conducted by researchers who hoped to find a new treatment.

name: 語態：been 與 being
description: have/has/had 之後接 been；am/is/are/was/were 之後接 being。兩者混用是 WE 的常見錯誤注入點。

example.sentence: The bridge has been closed for repairs since last month.

name: 分詞構句
description: 副詞子句減化：主詞與主要子句相同時，省略主詞、動詞改分詞（主動 V-ing、被動 V-ed）。句首分詞的邏輯主詞必須是主要子句的主詞。

example.sentence: Having finished the experiment, the students recorded their results in the lab notebook.

error_patterns: 完成分詞（having + V-ed）時序誤用

name: 垂懸修飾語（dangling modifier）
description: 句首分詞片語的邏輯主詞與主要子句主詞不一致即為垂懸修飾。台大正誤判斷題考過此類型。

example.sentence: Walking through the museum, the ancient sculptures impressed the visitors deeply.

error_patterns: 分詞邏輯主詞與主句主詞不一致

name: 動名詞與不定詞的選擇
description: enjoy、finish、avoid、consider、suggest 後接 V-ing；decide、hope、agree、refuse 後接 to V；stop/remember/forget 接兩者意思不同。

example.sentence: The committee finished reviewing the proposal and agreed to fund the project.

error_patterns: stop to V / stop V-ing 語意混淆

name: 介係詞後接動名詞
description: 介係詞（含 to 作介係詞的片語：look forward to、be used to、object to）之後必接名詞或 V-ing，不可接原形。

example.sentence: She is looking forward to studying abroad next year.

error_patterns: look forward to / be used to 後誤接原形動詞

name: 關係代名詞的選擇
description: 人用 who/whom、物用 which、兩者皆可用 that；所有格用 whose；介係詞後只能用 which/whom；逗號後非限定子句不可用 that。

example.sentence: The scientist whose research won the Nobel Prize will speak at the conference.

name: 關係子句減化
description: 關代 + be 可省略，留下分詞或片語：the book (which was) written by...。主動關係子句減化為 V-ing。

example.sentence: Mount Kilauea, a volcano located in Hawaii, is one of the most active volcanoes in the world.

error_patterns: 減化後殘留 be 動詞

name: 名詞子句
description: that/whether/what/how 引導的子句作主詞或受詞。what 內含先行詞（= the thing that），不可與先行詞並用；名詞子句永遠用直述句語序。

example.sentence: What the researchers discovered has changed our understanding of the disease.

error_patterns: 名詞子句誤用疑問句語序

name: 間接問句語序
description: 疑問詞引導的間接問句用直述語序（疑問詞 + 主詞 + 動詞），不倒裝、不加 do/does/did。

example.sentence: The reporter asked the mayor why the project had been delayed.

error_patterns: 間接問句殘留助動詞 do/does/did

name: 副詞子句連接詞的選擇
description: 依語意選連接詞：讓步（although/even though/while）、原因（because/since/as）、結果（so...that/such...that）、目的（so that）。另注意 because 子句 vs because of 片語。

example.sentence: Although the experiment failed, the researchers gained valuable insights from it.

error_patterns: although 與 but 連用（雙重連接）
because/because of 後接結構錯誤
so that/such that 結構混用

name: 假設語氣：與現在/過去事實相反
description: 與現在事實相反：If + 過去式, would + 原形；與過去事實相反：If + had Vpp, would have Vpp。be 動詞一律用 were。

example.sentence: If the company had invested in new technology earlier, it would not have lost its market share.

error_patterns: 條件句與主句時態組合錯誤
混合假設（過去條件、現在結果）誤判

name: wish / as if 的假設語氣
description: wish 後接過去式表與現在相反、過去完成式表與過去相反；as if/as though 同理。

example.sentence: She wishes she had taken the job offer when she had the chance.

error_patterns: as if 後時態退位遺漏

name: 倒裝：否定副詞開頭
description: Never、seldom、rarely、not only、hardly、no sooner 等否定副詞置句首時，主詞與助動詞須倒裝。

example.sentence: Never before had the city experienced such a severe drought.

error_patterns: 否定副詞開頭仍用一般語序
倒裝時助動詞選錯或遺漏

name: 倒裝：條件句省略 if
description: 假設語氣條件句可省略 if 並倒裝：Had + S + Vpp、Were + S、Should + S + 原形。

example.sentence: Had the doctor told Maxie about the side effects, he would have refused the medication.

error_patterns: 省略 if 後未倒裝

name: 倒裝：only 與地方副詞開頭
description: Only + 副詞（片語/子句）置句首時主句倒裝；地方副詞/介係詞片語開頭時全部倒裝（動詞在主詞前）。

example.sentence: Only after the storm passed did the rescue teams reach the stranded villagers.

error_patterns: 倒裝位置錯誤（副詞子句內誤倒裝）

name: 比較級與最高級的形式
description: 短形容詞 -er/-est、長形容詞 more/most，不可疊用（more better ✗）；比較級配 than、最高級配 the；不規則變化（good/better/best、little/less/least）。

example.sentence: The new laboratory is much larger than the old one.

name: 比較對象的對稱
description: 比較的兩端必須是同類事物，常需 that of / those of 代替重複名詞。

example.sentence: The climate of Taiwan is milder than that of Korea.

error_patterns: 比較對象不對稱（氣候比國家）
that of/those of 單複數錯誤

name: the + 比較級, the + 比較級
description: 「越…越…」句型：The + 比較級 + 子句, the + 比較級 + 子句。

example.sentence: The more you practice, the more confident you will become.

error_patterns: 兩邊比較級形式不一致

name: 平行結構
description: and、or、逗號串接的並列項必須同詞性同形式（名詞對名詞、V-ing 對 V-ing、to V 對 to V）。ITP Written Expression 前三高頻考點。

example.sentence: The manager praised the team for working quickly, carefully, and efficiently.

error_patterns: 並列動詞形式不一致（V-ing 混 to V）

name: 相關字組的對稱與一致
description: not only...but also、both...and、either...or、neither...nor 連接的兩端必須結構對稱；either...or 作主詞時動詞依最近主詞。

example.sentence: The new policy will benefit not only the students but also the faculty.

error_patterns: 相關字組配對錯誤（not only...and）
動詞一致就近原則誤判

name: 代名詞一致與指涉
description: 代名詞須與先行詞的單複數、性別一致：each student → his or her（ITP 規範答案）。注意：現代英語已普遍接受 singular they，但 ITP 傳統規範題仍以 his or her 為正解，出題與批改依考試規範判定。

example.sentence: Each of the students must submit his or her report before the deadline.

error_patterns: each/every 先行詞誤配 their（依 ITP 規範判錯）
代名詞指涉模糊或跳號（it/they 無明確先行詞）

name: 詞性選擇（word form）
description: 依句法位置選正確詞性：修飾動詞/形容詞用副詞、修飾名詞用形容詞、冠詞後接名詞。WE 高頻：economic/economical、successful/successive 等形近字。

example.sentence: The company grew rapidly because of its innovative marketing strategy.

name: 可數/不可數與量詞
description: many/few/number of + 可數複數；much/little/amount of + 不可數。information、equipment、furniture、advice 為不可數。

example.sentence: Scientists have gathered much information about how volcanoes form.

name: another / other / the other
description: another + 單數（泛指另一個）；other + 複數；the other(s) 特指剩下的。

example.sentence: Some students prefer online classes, while others enjoy learning in person.

error_patterns: other/the other 特指泛指混淆

name: 冠詞的使用
description: 單數可數名詞前須有限定詞；特指/最高級/序數用 the；母音音素開頭用 an（an hour、a university）。

example.sentence: The first astronaut to walk on the moon was Neil Armstrong.

error_patterns: a/an 依拼字而非發音誤判
不必要的 the（泛指複數/不可數）

name: 介係詞固定搭配
description: 動詞/形容詞/名詞的固定介係詞搭配：depend on、consist of、interested in、capable of、reason for。台大愛考 phrasal verbs 的介係詞替換。

example.sentence: The success of the project depends on the cooperation of all team members.

name: 副詞與形容詞的位置
description: 頻率副詞在一般動詞前、be 動詞後；enough 在形容詞後、名詞前；形容詞多重修飾有慣用順序（限定詞-評價-大小-新舊-顏色-國籍-材質）。

example.sentence: Hypothermia and altitude sickness are often the biggest dangers when climbing in the Himalayas.

error_patterns: 最高級與副詞順序顛倒

name: 情態助動詞
description: 情態助動詞（can/could/may/might/must/should/would）後接原形；must have Vpp 表對過去的肯定推測、should have Vpp 表過去該做未做。

example.sentence: The fossils must have been buried for millions of years before they were discovered.

error_patterns: must have/should have 語意混用

name: 使役與感官動詞
description: make/let/have + 受詞 + 原形；get + 受詞 + to V；感官動詞（see/hear/watch）+ 受詞 + 原形或 V-ing；被動使役 have something done。

example.sentence: The professor had his assistant collect the exam papers.

error_patterns: 使役動詞後誤接 to V
have something done 被動結構誤用主動

name: 多餘字與缺漏字
description: WE 專屬錯誤型：句中被插入多餘的代名詞、冠詞、介係詞或連接詞，或缺了必要的字。如 the man he is（多餘 he）、return back（語意重複）。

example.sentence: The results of the survey were more accurate than the researchers had expected.

error_patterns: 主詞後多餘代名詞複指

name: it 與 there 的虛主詞句型
description: there be + 名詞（存在句，be 依名詞單複數變化）；it 作虛主詞代替不定詞/子句（It is important to...）。

example.sentence: There are several reasons why the experiment produced unexpected results.

error_patterns: there be 動詞單複數錯誤

name: 名詞單複數形式
description: WE 高頻：上下文要求複數卻用單數（one of the + 複數、several/various + 複數）、不規則複數（phenomena、criteria、hypotheses）。

example.sentence: The aurora is one of the most spectacular natural phenomena in the polar regions.

error_patterns: one of the 後誤用單數

name: so / such / too / enough 的程度句型
description: so + adj + that 子句；such + (a) + adj + 名詞 + that；too + adj + to V（負面）；adj + enough + to V。

example.sentence: The lecture was so interesting that no one left before it ended.

name: 字彙語意搭配（collocation 正誤）
description: WE 與台大正誤題會注入語意不合的近義字：make/do、raise/rise、lie/lay、affect/effect、borrow/lend。

example.sentence: Sociolinguistics often makes use of traditional quantitative analysis in investigating language variation.

name: 連綴動詞與補語
description: 連綴動詞（be、become、seem、remain、taste、sound）後接形容詞作主詞補語，不接副詞。

example.sentence: Despite the criticism, the director remained confident about the film's success.

name: 數量詞與 of 片語
description: most/some/all/half + of + the + 名詞（有 of 必有限定詞）；most people（泛指）vs most of the people（特指）。

example.sentence: Most of the students in the class passed the final examination.
